page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Tolosan" and "IV.Dest." in the first note; "IX. r" in the margin (may be a section mark); "pussimum" in the text; the sign "+" after "rebellasse"; the sign "§" in the note "t". Hancinè: the large initial H is joined to the word. The first word of the second paragraph is printed "Nulli" followed by a long-s form, read as "Nulli iam". The reference marks {r}, {t} and {u} are placed where the printed marks stand in the text, because the printed mark in the text is not clear. Italic range in the second paragraph is uncertain, especially around "Christia-nos quoad temporalia". The top running head is printed as "Cap.5. Principum, Dissertatio."; the chapter number is left out as the instructions require.
